Understanding

  • I’m trying to learn language name
  • How do you say _____?
  • What is this? (while pointing or holding something)
  • I’m sorry / excuse me / apologies
  • I understand/understood
  • I don’t/didn't understand
  • Can you please repeat that?
  • Can I say ____? (to test out something you’re not sure is correct / acceptable)
